Solution B is correct. The SUV would use 12,000 / 15 = 800 gallons, and the hybrid would use 12,000 / 48 = 250 gallons. The difference is 800 − 250 = 550 gallons.

Solution A makes errors. It treats 15 and 48 as gallons per mile, which is wrong. Its alternative calculation also rounds 1/15 and 1/48 too early, giving 550.8 instead of 550. It then presents two conflicting answers.

WINNER: B
